strings.d1.s0.name: Magic Kingdom Park
strings.d1.s0.tips: Disney's flagship park. Rope drop is at 08:30 (TRON, Space Mountain). Lightning Lane Multi Pass is extra; tickets are online and date-specific (~160 USD).
strings.d1.s1.name: Columbia Harbour House Magic Kingdom
strings.d1.s1.tips: Quick-service meal inside the park; order ahead on the app.
strings.d1.s2.name: Happily Ever After Fireworks
strings.d1.s2.tips: Night show in front of Cinderella Castle; claim your spot 1 hour early.
strings.d1.b0.name: Disney Springs Chef Art Smith's Homecomin'
strings.d1.b0.tips: Fried chicken at Disney Springs; an evening outside the park.
strings.d1.b1.name: Disney Springs
strings.d1.b1.tips: Free entertainment and shopping district; an alternative to the fireworks.
strings.d2.s0.name: EPCOT
strings.d2.s0.tips: Guardians of the Galaxy and Frozen rides; World Showcase has 11 countries, plus seasonal festivals (Food & Wine in autumn).
strings.d2.s1.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food Tour
strings.d2.s1.tips: Croissants in the France pavilion, tacos in Mexico: snack your way from country to country.
strings.d2.s2.name: Luminous EPCOT Night Show
strings.d2.s2.tips: Light and water show over the lagoon.
strings.d2.b0.name: Space 220 EPCOT
strings.d2.b1.name: Disney's BoardWalk
strings.d3.s0.name: Universal Epic Universe
strings.d3.s0.tips: Park that opened in 2025: Super Nintendo World, Harry Potter Ministry, Dark Universe. Tickets cost 139-199 USD, with early entry available.
strings.d3.s1.name: Celestial Park Epic Universe Lunch
strings.d3.s1.tips: Restaurants at the heart of the park; try Atlantic (seafood).
strings.d3.s2.name: Universal CityWalk Orlando
strings.d3.s2.tips: Restaurant and bar district outside the parks; free.
strings.d3.b0.name: Toothsome Chocolate Emporium CityWalk
strings.d3.b1.name: Universal Islands of Adventure
strings.d3.b1.tips: VelociCoaster and Hogsmeade; an alternative to Epic.
strings.d4.s0.name: Disney's Hollywood Studios
strings.d4.s0.tips: Rise of the Resistance and Galaxy's Edge; spend the morning here.
strings.d4.s1.name: Docking Bay 7 Galaxy's Edge
strings.d4.s1.tips: Star Wars-themed meal; try the blue milk.
strings.d4.s2.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom
strings.d4.s2.tips: Go in the afternoon with a Park Hopper ticket; Kilimanjaro Safaris at sunset, Flight of Passage and Pandora at night.
strings.d4.b0.name: Tiffins Animal Kingdom
strings.d4.b1.name: Disney's Typhoon Lagoon
strings.d4.b1.tips: Water park; a summer alternative to Animal Kingdom.
strings.d5.s0.name: Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex
strings.d5.s0.tips: 1 hour from Orlando. See the Saturn V and Space Shuttle Atlantis, and take the bus tour to the launch pads. Check the launch schedule.
strings.d5.s1.name: Orbit Cafe Kennedy Space Center
strings.d5.s2.name: Cocoa Beach
strings.d5.s2.tips: Atlantic beach and pier; Ron Jon Surf Shop, and swimming in summer.
strings.d5.b0.name: Cocoa Beach Pier Restaurant
strings.d5.b1.name: Merritt Island Wildlife Refuge
strings.d5.b1.tips: Manatees and alligators; an alternative to the beach.
strings.d6.s0.name: Winter Park Scenic Boat Tour
strings.d6.s0.tips: A 1-hour boat tour through lakes and canals, running since 1938, past mansion gardens.
strings.d6.s1.name: Park Avenue Winter Park
strings.d6.s1.tips: Elegant street with boutiques and the Morse Museum (Tiffany glass, 6 USD).
strings.d6.s2.name: Prato Winter Park
strings.d6.s2.tips: Italian restaurant on Park Avenue; wood-fired oven.
strings.d6.s3.name: Charles Hosmer Morse Museum
strings.d6.s4.name: The Wheel at ICON Park
strings.d6.s4.tips: 120 m Ferris wheel on International Drive; go at sunset.
strings.d6.b0.name: The Ravenous Pig Winter Park
strings.d6.b1.name: Orlando Museum of Art
strings.d6.b1.tips: Museum in Loch Haven; an alternative to the Morse.
strings.d7.s0.name: Lake Eola Park
strings.d7.s0.tips: Lake in the city centre; swan boats and a Sunday market.
strings.d7.s1.name: Se7en Bites
strings.d7.s1.tips: Southern-style breakfast and pies; a stop before you leave.
strings.d7.s2.name: East End Market
strings.d7.s2.tips: Local food market; good for souvenirs.
strings.d7.s3.name: Orlando International Airport
strings.d7.s3.tips: The airport is 20 minutes away; farewell.
strings.d7.b0.name: Mills 50 Vietnamese District
strings.d7.b0.tips: Pho and banh mi; an alternative to Se7en Bites.
strings.d7.b1.name: Harry P. Leu Gardens
strings.d7.b1.tips: Botanical garden; an alternative to the market.
strings.note0: Orlando is a car city: hire a car (parking at the parks is 30 USD) or use the Disney/Universal buses. You need a car for Kennedy.
strings.note1: Summer brings 33°C, high humidity and a storm every afternoon (parks pause for 1 hour). Do rope drop in the morning, rest at the hotel pool from 13:00 to 16:00, and stay in the park in the evening. It is hurricane season.
strings.note2: Park tickets are date-specific and online. Lightning Lane/Express Pass is worth it in the crowds; mobile ordering skips the queue.
strings.note3: Meals in the parks cost 15-25 USD. Book restaurants 60 days ahead. Refill your water bottle (free).
strings.note4: Tip 18-20%. Outside the parks, Mills 50 and Winter Park are local and cheap.
strings.note5: In 7 days: 4 Disney parks plus 2-3 Universal parks. If there is a launch at Kennedy, plan around that day.
